page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block from top to bottom; below it an engraved vignette with imprint beneath; stamps and handwriting at right are not printed text.

main_text.l: Perscripta ad ordinem librorum, capitum, articulorum
& sententiarum seu comprehensionum eius, ita vt
alterum scriptum cum altero facile in sin-
Tuus sum, conserua me: quia mandata tua quaerebam.

page.notes: The engraved vignette (a female figure seated within a wreath, with the banner WATOP and the Greek legend) is not transcribed. Round stamps at right ("Vermisserte" / "Bibliotheca ... Pr. Stolp") and handwritten marks ("Consistorium", "1602", "(Verzeichnet)") are not printed text. The imprint date is printed as "CIↃ. Iↄ CII" and is given here as MDCII. The last line of the motto is printed "quia mandata tua quaerebam" in the scan, partly obscured; the reading "quaerebam" is uncertain.
